graphRunnerApi.bootstrapStorage: () => Promise<{ ok: boolean; recoveredDrafts: RecoveredDraft[]; storageMode: 'capacitor_wal' | 'web_opfs_worker' | 'memory' }> (ejecuta migrateIncompatibleCheckpoints y reconcilia hilos interrumpidos a medias UPDATE chat_threads SET status='error' WHERE status='running')
graphRunnerApi.createThread: (params?: { title?: string; active_job_id?: string | null; active_quote_id?: string | null }) => Promise<ChatThreadRecord>
graphRunnerApi.reopenRecoveredDraft: (draftId: string) => Promise<TurnExecutionResult> (crea thread nuevo congelado vía configurable.seed_override.recoveredDraftOverride en Gate 1/2 y marca recovered_drafts.dismissed = 1)
graphRunnerApi.getThreadState: (threadId: string) => Promise<{ thread: ChatThreadRecord; checkpointStatus: 'idle' | 'interrupted'; activeInterrupt: InterruptPayload | null; messages: ChatMessageRecord[] }>
graphRunnerApi.rehydrateActiveThread: () => Promise<{ threadId: string | null; activeInterrupt: InterruptPayload | null; recoveredDrafts: RecoveredDraft[] }> (appRestoredResult de cámara se procesa aparte en main.tsx vía cameraAdapter.ingestRestoredPhoto esperando appReadyPromise)

directory.clientsCrud: ClientRepository: listPaginated(opts?: { search?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number }) -> Promise<{ items: ClientRow[]; totalCount: number }> / create / update / delete (bloquea borrado si existen jobs/quotes/invoices)
directory.catalogCrud: CatalogRepository: listPaginated(opts?: { search?: string; category?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number }) -> Promise<{ items: CatalogItemRow[]; totalCount: number }> / create / update / deactivate
directory.jobsOps: JobRepository: listPaginated(opts?: { search?: string; status?: JobStatus; limit?: number; offset?: number }) / createDirectJob(OBR) / transitionStatus(pendiente|en_curso|finalizado|cancelado)
directory.documentOpener: DocumentOpenerService: openPdf(pdfUri: string | null, docKind: 'quote' | 'invoice', docId: string, pdfPort: PdfPort) -> Promise<void> (regenera vía PdfPort si falta; en Web abre URL.createObjectURL + descarga fallback; en Nativo abre @capacitor/share con toShareableNativeUri sin mutar sent_at_iso)
directory.ticketsCrud: TicketRepository: listByQuarterOrJob(opts: { quarter?: string; jobId?: string | null; limit?: number; offset?: number }) / updateWithin2Cents / delete (llama fileBridge.deleteCommittedMedia(image_uri)) / checkDuplicate
directory.siteLogsCrud: SiteLogService: stampAndSave(input: SiteLogInput) -> Promise<SiteLogRecord> (si viene new_job, crea OBR + site_log en única inTransaction)

settingsService.configureSequences: (fiscalYear: number, overrides: Partial<Record<'PRE'|'ANT'|'FAC'|'OBR', number>>) => Promise<void> (valida valor >= máximo emitido en fiscalYear)
settingsService.setLocalLlmConfig: (enabled: boolean, modelUri: string | null) => Promise<AppSettingsRecord> (en Web la referencia File vive en sesión salvo copia OPFS explícita; si no hay handle en recarga limpia llm_enabled=0)
settingsService.unloadLocalLlm: () => Promise<void> (invoca memoryCoordinator.releaseLlmIfLoaded() registrado externamente desde features/llm)

chatMaintenanceService.deleteClosedThread: (threadId: string) => Promise<void> (exige status !== 'interrupted', limpia app_settings.last_active_thread_id=null si coincide, elimina chat_thread y ejecuta checkpointsRepo.deleteThreadCheckpoints(threadId))
chatMaintenanceService.purgeClosedHistory: () => Promise<{ deletedCount: number }> (borra únicamente threads con status IN ('idle','error'), limpia last_active_thread_id=null si estaba entre los eliminados y borra checkpoints vía checkpointsRepo)

backupAndDemo.importBackupJson: (envelope: SymmetricBackupEnvelope | string, password?: string) => Promise<{ ok: true; restoredCounts: Record<string, number> }> (en único inTransaction usando exclusivamente tx: purga en orden inverso FK chat_messages, chat_threads, recovered_drafts, agent_traces, lg_checkpoint_writes, lg_checkpoints, feedback_corrections, site_logs, expense_tickets, quote_items, invoices, quotes, jobs, clients, catalog_items, sequences; reinicia app_settings.last_active_thread_id=null y pending_camera_context_json=null; e inserta datos validados del backup — sin reentrancia FIFO)
backupAndDemo.restoreDemoData: (freezer: SeedGraphFreezerPort) => Promise<void> (Fase 1 en src/core/backup/resetService.ts dentro de inTransaction vía tx: purga dominio/chat/trazas/checkpoints e inserta maestro, dominio, chat_threads/chat_messages y tr_seed_03..05 desde seedData JSON; Fase 2 fuera de inTransaction tras COMMIT: invoca freezer.freezeDemoGates() en src/agent/demoSeeder.ts para congelar thr-seed-01-gate1 y thr-seed-02-gate2)
backupAndDemo.startFromScratch: (seedSequences?: Partial<Record<'PRE'|'ANT'|'FAC'|'OBR', number>>) => Promise<void> (en único inTransaction vía tx: purga dominio/chat/trazas + lg_checkpoint_writes y lg_checkpoints en orden inverso FK; reinicia app_settings con emitter_name='', emitter_nif='', emitter_fiscal_address='', emitter_phone='', last_active_thread_id=null, pending_camera_context_json=null, boot_mode='clean'; e inserta seedSequences opcionales)

seedingStrategy.notes: Ejecución estricta en 2 fases desacoplada por SeedGraphFreezerPort: (Fase 1, src/core/backup/resetService.ts dentro de único inTransaction vía tx) purga tablas/checkpoints e inserta maestro, dominio, chat_threads, chat_messages y trazas históricas de escenarios 3–5 (tr_seed_03_pre, tr_seed_03_post, tr_seed_04_qa, tr_seed_04_fiscal, tr_seed_05_sl). (Fase 2, src/agent/demoSeeder.ts implementando freezeDemoGates() fuera de inTransaction tras el COMMIT) congela thr-seed-01-gate1 y thr-seed-02-gate2 ejecutando compiledGraph.invoke(replayInputToFreeze, { configurable: { thread_id, seed_override } }), mapeando quoteFixtureOverride.trace_id / ocrFixtureOverride.trace_id hacia seed_override.traceIdOverride ('tr_seed_01_pre' | 'tr_seed_02_pre') y grabando lg_checkpoints + __interrupt__ sin cargar WASM OCR ni pdfmake.
